SPF hospital field denominator says emergency passages while narrative says admissions; both are retained without recalculation. https://odisse.santepubliquefrance.fr/explore/dataset/covid-19-passages-aux-urgences-et-actes-sos-medecins-region/

records.case_definition: Source-native weekly measurement; keep source population, origin/age/metric dimensions, calendar, explicit zero/missing and original units. records.case_definition: Source-native weekly measurement; keep source population, origin/age/metric dimensions, calendar, explicit zero/missing and original units. No patient-case projection, no total/subtype/origin/age sum; no conversion from tests or rates into cases. SPF hospital field denominator says emergency passages while narrative says admissions; both are retained without recalculation. https://odisse.santepubliquefrance.fr/explore/dataset/covid-19-passages-aux-urgences-et-actes-sos-medecins-region/
